GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH AllMarketplaceSales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', oms.order_date) AS month_start_date,
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        TRY_CAST(oms.total_amount AS DOUBLE) AS gross_sales_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms oms
    WHERE
        oms.group_level_id = '22'
        AND oms.is_active = true
        AND oms.order_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement.settlement_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        'LimeRoad' AS marketplace_name,
        settlement.gmv_amount AS gross_sales_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.limeroad_settlement settlement
    WHERE
        settlement.group_level_id = '22'
        AND settlement.is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND settlement.order_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', sales.order_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        sales.sales_channel AS marketplace_name,
        sales.total_amount AS gross_sales_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales sales
    WHERE
        sales.group_level_id = '22'
        AND sales.is_active = true
        AND sales.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
        AND sales.transaction_type = 'SALES'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', amazon_oms.order_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        'Amazon' AS marketplace_name,
        TRY_CAST(amazon_oms.total_amount AS DOUBLE) AS gross_sales_amount -- Inferred sales amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms amazon_oms
    WHERE
        amazon_oms.group_level_id = '22'
        AND amazon_oms.is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND amazon_oms.order_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', meesho_sales.order_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        'Meesho' AS marketplace_name,
        meesho_sales.charged_amount AS gross_sales_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.meesho_sales meesho_sales
    WHERE
        meesho_sales.group_level_id = '22'
        AND meesho_sales.is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND meesho_sales.order_status = 'Delivered'
)
SELECT
    month_start_date,
    marketplace_name,
    SUM(gross_sales_amount) AS total_gross_sales
FROM
    AllMarketplaceSales
GROUP BY
    month_start_date,
    marketplace_name
ORDER BY
    month_start_date, marketplace_name;
